apktool d thermostat.apk -o decoded_apk && find decoded_apk -name "*.smali" -exec grep -l "getResources" {} \; && xxd decoded_apk/res/values/strings.xml | grep -oP '"\K[^"]+'
```

*(Decoding strings.xml for embedded resource strings.)*

```bash
find decoded_apk -name "*.smali" -exec grep -l "android.widget.TextView" {} \; && grep -r "setContentView" decoded_apk/src/main/res/layout/ -l
```

*(Locating TextView references and activity layouts in SMALI files.)*

```bash
apktool d thermostat.apk -o decoded_apk && find decoded_apk/res/layout/ -name "*.xml" -exec cat {} \; | grep -oP '"(.*?)"' | grep -v 'android:' | sort -u
```

*(Extracting all quoted strings from XML layouts.)*

```bash
find decoded_apk -name "*.smali" -exec grep -l "setText" {} \; && grep -r "password\|flag\|admin\|secret" decoded_apk -i
```

*(Searching SMALI files for setText operations and strings for hidden credentials.)*

```bash
find decoded_apk -name "*.smali" -exec grep -A5 -B5 "getString" {} \; | grep -v "R\." | grep -oP '"[^"]*"' | sort -u
```

*(Extracting all strings used by getString calls in SMALI files.)*

```bash
apktool d thermostat.apk -o decoded_apk && find decoded_apk -name "*.smali" -exec grep -l "onClick" {} \; && grep -r "Intent" decoded_apk/src/main/java/ -A3 -B3

```bash
find decoded_apk -name "*.smali" | xargs grep -l "return-*" && cat decoded_apk/src/main/java/com/example/thermostat/*.java | grep -i "flag\|secret\|admin\|password"

```bash
strings decoded_apk/ | grep -i "flag\|admin\|secret\|password" | sort -u
